svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 03 · Davis · 09/12 Tomato Harvest (Common)
svg.desc: Late summer, the trucks roll past heaped red with tomatoes. The whole road smells like it. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
